user_machine_keyword_train._comment: null (use machine.json default), str (shortcut used in machine.json (ex: a100), list of str (project,allocation,arch, ex [myproject,myalloc,a100])

user_machine_keyword_freeze._comment: null (use machine.json default), str (shortcut used in machine.json (ex: v100), list of str (project,allocation,arch, ex [myproject,myalloc,v100])

user_machine_keyword_compress._comment: null (use machine.json default), str (shortcut used in machine.json (ex: v100), list of str (project,allocation,arch, ex [myproject,myalloc,v100])

deepmd_model_version._comment: str (nnp_program: deepmd only), values: 2.0, 2.1, 2.2 or 3.0. Omit the key entirely to take the highest dptrain_VERSION.json version found in the user_files folder

mace_model_version._comment: str (nnp_program: mace only). Omit the key entirely to take the highest mace_MACEVERSION.yml/.yaml version found in the user_files folder

mean_s_per_step._comment: float, estimated training seconds/step used to auto-compute job_walltime_train_h on the very first training; later iterations measure it from the previous run instead
